answer.reason: The mutant removes the FileSchema check, so every value is treated as a document. Unsupported values then fail with an AttributeError instead of a clean TypeError, and images and videos are misrouted into the file path. Document normalisation has to recognise only supported document inputs, so this change breaks that promise.
sources: Provider routes that declare document input support shall accept a supported document input and return structured output grounded in the document contents.
answer.test_focus: Check that describe_media returns FileMedia only for a FileSchema, and that a non-document value such as a plain string raises TypeError with the "Unsupported media value" message.
